line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.2: Legacy starting questions (commented out) have been removed. Also reorganized question IDs and choices (see 9972-L044.xml).
* Quickstart.
* Validate starting options and ascension path.
* === Difficulty selection ===
* Add-Ons 1.2: preparation for insane mode: check if index is >= 2 instead of == 2.
* Overall difficulty is stored in OCV difficulty.
* Herobetty 4.6: update the Perk table one last time.
* This is because the player will have selected 1 of the 4 difficulties, and hard (and insane) mode changes the description and effect of the insurance policy perk.
* === Standard starting options. ===
* Add-Ons 2.2: Only bonus ship and ascension are now asked.
* Money is fixed at 20k. The origin sector is revealed along with nearby sectors capped at 5% of the galaxy or 5 sectors, whichever is fewer.
* Bonus ship
* Ascension
* === End starting questions. Skipped if Quickstart was selected. ===
* This is not necessarily the player's current ship! This is the player's starting ship, i.e., the starting M4.
* Ascension is initialized after all starting-option overrides are resolved.
* Expanded 2.2: Initialize Black Market metadata after starting options have been resolved.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Player gets starting items only on easy/normal/hard.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Only the starting ship blueprint is given; this is back to what it was prior to Renegades. The Galleon and TLS blueprints are no longer provided for the following reasons:
* - Capital ships already bail, making the early Galleon redundant. Also, the Galleon blueprint was initially added to demonstrate Renegades' improved carrier-based logic.
* - The player has other means to repair ships (any Outpost). It also encourages decision-making to either keep repairing or ultimately salvage the ship.
* 1. Resolve bonus ship.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Spawn at a random position in the origin sector instead of beside the player's current ship.
* The player can still move via strafing during starting questions, so the current ship position is not a stable spawn reference.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Blueprint and docking computer (for TP) are no longer given.
* BuildShip handles standard equipment. However, player-built Spitfyres do not receive lasers, so equip their lasers separately.
* Player did not pick a bonus ship. Player's starting ship gains +1 Pandora Tuning.
* 2. Resolve starting money.
* Add-Ons 2.2: 20k is always awarded on lower difficulties.
* 3. Resolve starting reputation and sector reveal.
* - Starting reputation is granted only with the origin faction. This must be done before the sector reveal to properly place and maintain satellites.
* - Starting reputation with origin faction is +1000; Quickstart receives +3333.
* - Add-Ons 1.8.1: Not applicable for Xenon Start.
* - Add-Ons 2.2: Now handles starting reputation for Quickstart.
* Reveal sectors up to 2 jumps away.
* Add-Ons 1.13: Must be allies with the sector owner in order to spawn free satellites.
* This check never occurs on insane mode, so check if notoriety is less than 3333 (rank 6, better source of truth than rank).
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Removed revealall answer.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Reveal up to 5 random sectors or 5% of the galaxy, whichever is fewer. The player's sector is free.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Apply -1000 reputation to every Commonwealth faction except the origin race.
* Generate a randomized set of blueprints consisting of Xenon/OCV ships. This is saved until the player joins the OCV (see ZH.SyntheticDawnCompletion.xml).
* Sets ambition to 4 (special).
* -1000 reputation with EVERY commonwealth faction except origin race.
* Add-Ons 2.2: No need for permanent war check anymore because permanent war is no longer set at the start of the game.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Initialize Ascension requirements only after all starting options have been resolved.
* Add-Ons 2.0: Quickstart displays its own message.
* Send a message notifying the player of the lack of extras at start of game and to check encyclopedia for insane mode rules.
